### OBS Studio Version (Other)

_No response_

### OBS Studio Log URL

https://obsproject.com/logs/MuZMpCXD2McpYPXx

### OBS Studio Crash Log URL

_No response_

### Expected Behavior

Media file to play again when retriggered

### Current Behavior

If media file ends and closes, before hidden w/ transition, then it will not open to play again.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Media Source, local file mp4, Restart playback, Use hardware decoding, show nothing when playing ends, and close file when inactive checked and hide the source.
2. Set a start and end transition for the media file.
3. Unhide source, let media file play, end, and close, then hide source
4. When you now unhide that source, the video file will no longer trigger.
5. If you edit the source, or change scenes and change back, the media source will trigger again, but only once
6. If you hide the media file before it ends and closes, and it allows the transition to occur, the media file will play again no problem, until it closes before the transition can occur.
...


### Anything else we should know?

Yall rock.

_No response_

### Expected Behavior

A window capture shows at the moment that I switch to a scene contains it.

### Current Behavior

A window capture shows 1 second later after I switch to a scene contains it.
![a](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/55237525/121762100-5ea66d00-cb66-11eb-8e1d-e4680f630bfb.png)


### Steps to Reproduce

1. Create a window capture. Any capture method has this issue. 
2. Create another scene. It can contain the window capture that you just created or other sources. The issue will happen whether the scenes you switch from or to.
3. Open studio mode or this issue won't happen.
4. Switch the two scenes. You'll see that the window capture shows about a second after you switch the scenes.
